notes: Some models report no context window; used 32768 tokens for them in the Continue config.

preflight.why: Continue CLI needs Node 20+ (docs; engines says >=18)

tempFiles.contents:
name: "OmniRoute Launch"
version: "1.0.0"
schema: v1
models:
  - name: mystery/unknown-context
    provider: openai
    model: mystery/unknown-context
    apiBase: "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1"
    apiKey: "${{ secrets.OMNIROUTE_API_KEY }}"
    roles:
      - chat
      - edit
      - apply
    defaultCompletionOptions:
      contextLength: 32768
      maxTokens: 8192
  - name: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6
    provider: openai
    model: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6
    apiBase: "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1"
    apiKey: "${{ secrets.OMNIROUTE_API_KEY }}"
    roles:
      - chat
      - edit
      - apply
    defaultCompletionOptions:
      contextLength: 200000
      maxTokens: 50000
  - name: openai/gpt-5.2
    provider: openai
    model: openai/gpt-5.2
    apiBase: "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1"
    apiKey: "${{ secrets.OMNIROUTE_API_KEY }}"
    roles:
      - chat
      - edit
      - apply
    defaultCompletionOptions:
      contextLength: 400000
      maxTokens: 100000
  - name: small/ctx-32k
    provider: openai
    model: small/ctx-32k
    apiBase: "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1"
    apiKey: "${{ secrets.OMNIROUTE_API_KEY }}"
    roles:
      - chat
      - edit
      - apply
    defaultCompletionOptions:
      contextLength: 32768
      maxTokens: 8192
  - name: fastest
    provider: openai
    model: fastest
    apiBase: "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1"
    apiKey: "${{ secrets.OMNIROUTE_API_KEY }}"
    roles:
      - chat
      - edit
      - apply
    defaultCompletionOptions:
      contextLength: 128000
      maxTokens: 32000
